name: Multi-Module Inventory Management Service
description: A multi-module inventory management service and CLI application requiring coherent architecture, modular contracts, and data persistence. The system must include: 1. Data models with validation for quantity and price. 2. Persistence layer for repository storage in a JSON file database. 3. Service workflow layer managing stock transactions, reorders, and inventory lifecycle. 4. Reporting module providing inventory metrics, statistics, and low-stock alerts. 5. CLI interface executable via main.py supporting add, restock, sell, and report commands. Must handle malformed files, negative stock errors, missing arguments, and corrupt storage records gracefully.
acceptance_criteria: Implement modular architecture with separate models, storage repository, service logic, and CLI entry point.
Data model enforces valid item attributes (id, name, quantity >= 0, unit_price >= 0.0).
Persistence layer stores items in a JSON repository file, surviving process restarts.
Service layer supports add item, restock quantity, sell quantity, and inventory valuation.
Prevent selling more units than available stock, raising appropriate validation errors without state corruption.
Reporting feature provides total inventory valuation and low-stock warnings.
Handle non-existent or corrupt storage files cleanly with informative stderr messages.
Executable CLI via main.py supporting --help exiting code 0.
Include automated behavioral unit tests in test_main.py covering module interactions.
